Coefficients and predictions along a selection path

Source: R/select_lasso.R
coef.pp_lasso.Rd

Coefficients and predictions along a selection path

Usage

# S3 method for class 'pp_lasso'
coef(object, lambda = NULL, which = NULL, drop = TRUE, ...)

# S3 method for class 'pp_lasso'
predict(
  object,
  newdata = NULL,
  lambda = NULL,
  which = NULL,
  type = c("link", "response"),
  unseen = c("missing", "median"),
  ...
)

selected_covariates(object, lambda = NULL, which = NULL)

Arguments

object

a path from var_select() or var_select().

lambda

penalty values at which to report; values between two points of the path are interpolated linearly.

which

alternatively, indices into object$lambda; default all.

drop

return vectors when a single value is requested.

...

unused.

newdata

a data frame with the covariate and provider columns of the fit; default the fitted rows.

type

"link" (the linear predictor, including any offset) or "response": the probability for the logistic model, the relative hazard \(e^\eta\) for the Cox model, and for the discrete-time model the probability of the event by the row's time, \(1 - \prod_k (1 - h_{jk})\) over the fit's periods up to that time (a time between two periods counts up to the earlier one, a time before the first period counts the first).

unseen

for providers of newdata that are not in the fit: "missing" (default; NA) or "median" (the median provider effect). Not used by the Cox model, which has no provider parameters.

Value

coef(): a list with gamma (NULL for the Cox model) and beta, plus alpha for the discrete-time model (matrices, or vectors with drop = TRUE and one value of lambda). predict(): a matrix with one column per requested lambda. selected_covariates(): the names of the penalized covariates with a nonzero coefficient, as a list over lambda.

Examples

d <- sim_kecc(n_providers = 20, n_covariates = 6, seed = 1)
pd <- pp_data(d, y = "y", x = paste0("x", 1:6), provider = "provider",
              patient = "patient", message = FALSE)
path <- var_select(pd, n_lambda = 20)
selected_covariates(path, which = c(5, 15))
#> $`0.0139041`
#> [1] "x1" "x2" "x3" "x4" "x5" "x6"
#> 
#> $`0.000109114`
#> [1] "x1" "x2" "x3" "x4" "x5" "x6"
#> 
head(predict(path, which = 15, type = "response"))
#>      0.000109114
#> [1,]   0.5765182
#> [2,]   0.4244555
#> [3,]   0.5604338
#> [4,]   0.4192023
#> [5,]   0.2504631
#> [6,]   0.2823876
